chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Fazal, from the one whom he mentioned, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Cupping in the head is the reliever; it benefits from every illness except Al-Sam (death/epidemic). And [the area is] a span from the two eyebrows to where the thumb reaches. Then he said: 'Here.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and physical benefit of cupping in the head according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies head cupping as a potent therapeutic intervention effective against all ailments except 'Al-Sam' (often interpreted as death or a specific incurable plague), highlighting the Prophetic tradition of practical medicine. The specific anatomical guidance—spanning from the eyebrows to the point where the thumb reaches—reflects the detailed clinical precision characteristic of Shia hadith literature, linking physical healing to spiritual well-being.

en.hubeali: H 14608 – Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Fazzaal, from the one whom he mentioned, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws having said:

‘The cupping in the head is beneficial from every illness except for the death, and ‘Shibr’ (the length of an extended palm) from both the eyebrows to where his thumb reaches’ (centre of the head)[18]. Then said: ‘Like here’.
en.sarwar: 160. Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Fazzaal, from the one whom he mentioned, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) having said:

‘The cupping in the head is beneficial from every illness except for the death, and ‘Shibr’ (the length of an extended palm) from both the eyebrows to where his thumb reaches’ (centre of the head). Then said: ‘Like here’.
